Story: As a Customer, I want to search for available flights such that I can specify departure/arrival airports, departure/ arrival dates, and passenger count that is suitable for my demand.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) User can enter departure and arrival airports; 2) User can pick departure (and optional return) dates; 3) Passenger count accepted and validated; 4) System returns list of available flights with price and seats remaining; 5) Filters for non-stop/one-stop and class available.

Story: As a Customer, I want to book tickets for multiple passengers such that I can provide detailed information and complete reservations for my family or group travel
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Booking flow accepts N passengers and collects passenger details for each; 2) System reserves seats and issues a single confirmation for group; 3) Validation for required passenger fields; 4) Pricing summary shows per-passenger and total.

Story: As a Customer, I want to manage my booking and view my booking history such that I can keep track of my travel arrangements and past trips.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Authenticated users can view a list of current and past bookings; 2) Users can view booking details and make allowed modifications (cancellations, upgrades) per policy; 3) Booking status updates reflected in UI.

Story: As a Customer, I want to contact for customer support via chat in real-time such that I can get immediate assistance with my bookings or travel-related questions.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Users can open a chat window to contact support; 2) Messages delivered in real-time between user and agent; 3) Chat history stored with the booking context; 4) Escalation option available.

Story: As a Customer, I want to look up my bookings using confirmation codes such that I can quickly access my reservation details without logging in.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Public lookup page accepts confirmation codes and returns booking summary; 2) Sensitive fields masked unless authorized; 3) Link to manage booking when logged in.

Story: As a Customer, I want to select seats and view seat maps such that I can choose my preferred seating arrangements for my flights.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Seat map displays available/blocked/taken seats; 2) Customer can select seats for each passenger in the booking; 3) Selection validated and persisted; 4) Pricing for paid seats shown.

Story: As a Customer, I want to make secure payments through integrated payment gateways such that I can complete my bookings with confidence in transaction security.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Payment page integrates with at least one gateway (test mode); 2) Payment form is PCI-compliant (tokenization simulated); 3) Successful payment transitions booking to confirmed and issues receipt; 4) Failed payments return clear errors.

Story: As a Flight Scheduling Employee, I want to create flight schedules such that I can ensure proper route planning and operational efficiency.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Employee can create flights with route, aircraft, departure/arrival times, and frequency; 2) Validation for aircraft availability and slot conflicts; 3) New schedule reflected in search results when published.

Story: As a Flight Scheduling Employee, I want to monitor flight operation and make real-time adjustments such that I can respond to operational changes and maintain schedule integrity.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Dashboard shows flight statuses (on-time, delayed, cancelled); 2) Employee can adjust times/status and notify affected bookings; 3) Audit log of changes recorded.

Story: As a Flight Scheduling Employee, I want to manage flight information and schedules such that I can maintain accurate and current flight data.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) CRUD for flight definitions and published schedules; 2) Versioning or effective-dates for schedule changes; 3) Changes visible to search and booking flows.

Story: As a Passenger Service Agent, I want to search flights for customers and assist with booking processes such that I can provide personalized service and support complex booking requirements.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Agent UI to search and hold/book flights on behalf of customers; 2) Ability to add notes and special requests; 3) Permissions restrict agent actions to allowed functions.

Story: As a Passenger Service Agent, I want to manage seat assignments and handle special seating requests such that I can accommodate customer preferences and special needs.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Agents can view and modify seat assignments; 2) Special requests recorded on booking; 3) Seat changes validated against aircraft map.

Story: As a Passenger Service Agent, I want to process payments such that I can complete sales transactions and assist with booking changes.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Agent payment workflow available with same security constraints; 2) Receipts and payment records stored; 3) Refunds and adjustments supported.

Story: As a Passenger Service Agent, I want to access customer booking information and handle ticket modifications such that I can provide support and resolve booking-related issues.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Agents can lookup bookings and perform allowed modifications; 2) Authorization and audit logging for agent actions; 3) Notifications sent to customer on changes.

Story: As a Passenger Service Agent, I want to engage in real-time chat with customers such that I can provide immediate assistance and resolve issues quickly.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Agents see assigned chats and can message customers; 2) Chat transcripts saved to booking; 3) Transfer/escalate options present.

Story: As a Passenger Service Agent, I want to escalate complex issues to specialized departments such that I can ensure customers receive appropriate expert assistance.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Agent can tag/transfer chat or create escalation ticket; 2) Escalation notifies appropriate team; 3) Status tracked until resolution.

Story: As a Passenger Service Agent, I want to access terms and privacy such that I can provide accurate business policies information to customers.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Terms/privacy pages available and searchable; 2) Agents can reference or link to policy versions; 3) Latest effective version highlighted.

Story: As a Operations Administrator, I want to manage the aircrafts database including specifications and maintenance schedules such that I can ensure operational readiness and safety compliance.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) CRUD for aircraft records and maintenance schedules; 2) Maintenance windows prevent schedule assignments; 3) Reports on aircraft availability.

Story: As a Operations Administrator, I want to manage the airports database with operational details such that I can support accurate flight planning and operations.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) CRUD for airports with codes, timezones, slots; 2) Validation for missing operational data; 3) Airport-level constraints used during scheduling.

Story: As a Operations Administrator, I want to manage ticket classes and pricing structures such that I can optimize revenue management and service offerings.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Define classes (Economy, Business, etc.) and fare rules; 2) Price calendars and overrides supported; 3) Pricing reflected in search and booking.

Story: As a Operations Administrator, I want to set system parameters and business rules such that I can ensure operations comply with regulations and company policies.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Admin UI for global parameters (cancellation policy, fees); 2) Rules applied during booking/changes; 3) Changes audited.

Story: As an Accounting Employee, I want to access financial reports and revenue analytics such that I can monitor business performance and support financial planning.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Pre-built revenue and bookings reports; 2) Exportable CSV/PDF; 3) Date-range and grouping filters.

Story: As an Accounting Employee, I want to track booking revenues and refund process such that I can maintain accurate financial records and cash flow management.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Transaction ledger for bookings/payments/refunds; 2) Reconciliation views; 3) Refund workflow with approvals logged.

Story: As an Accounting Employee, I want to GENERATE FORECAST.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Basic forecasting tool using historical bookings; 2) Exportable results; 3) Adjustable parameters (seasonality, growth).

Story: As a System Administrator, I want to have complete access to all system functions and configurations such that I can ensure system integrity and optimal performance.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Admin role with access to all management screens; 2) Role-based access control tests passed; 3) Sensitive actions require MFA/confirmation.

Story: As a System Administrator, I want to manage user accounts (including employee and customer accounts) across all roles such that I can maintain security and organizational access control.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) CRUD for users and role assignments; 2) Password reset and account locking; 3) Admin audit logs.

Story: As a System Administrator, I want to track employee access and system usage such that I can ensure compliance with security policies and identify training needs.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Access logs and usage dashboards; 2) Filters by user/period; 3) Exportable audit evidence.

Story: As a System Administrator, I want to access comprehensive system analytics and performance metrics such that I can monitor system health and plan for capacity needs.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Metrics for response times, error rates, active sessions; 2) Alerting thresholds; 3) Historical trends.

Story: As a System User, I want to have secure authentication with role-based access such that I can access appropriate features while maintaining system security.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Login with secure password storage; 2) Roles restrict UI and API access; 3) Session management and logout.

Story: As a System User, I want to use a responsive interface that works on desktop and mobile devices such that I can access the system from various devices and locations.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Key flows responsive on common breakpoints; 2) Navigation and forms usable on mobile; 3) Cross-browser compatibility checks.

Story: As a System User, I want to receive real-time updates and notifications such that I can stay informed about relevant changes and communications.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Push/real-time notifications for booking changes and chat; 2) Notification center in UI; 3) Users can opt-in/out.

Story: As a System User, I want to have reliable system performance with fast loading times such that I can complete my tasks efficiently without delays.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) Page load targets defined (<3s for key pages); 2) Caching and pagination used where applicable; 3) Performance monitored.

Story: As a System User, I want to have Vietnamese language support such that I can use the system in my preferred language with clear understanding.
Acceptance Criteria: 1) UI supports Vietnamese translations for key flows; 2) Language toggle in settings; 3) Translations complete for core pages.
